# Photo slots

Each `<figure class="photo">` shows a designed navy panel until the matching file exists here.
Add the file, rebuild, and the photo appears. Use JPEG, around 1600px on the long side, under 300 KB.

| File | Where it shows | What to shoot |
|---|---|---|
| `hero.jpg` | Home hero (4:5 portrait on desktop, 16:11 on phones) | The 400 Texas St entrance or the office doorway with the J&L name visible. Late afternoon light. |
| `paperwork.jpg` | Home, "What it costs" (16:10) | Hands signing a bond agreement at the desk, or the desk with pen and forms. No faces needed. |
| `team.jpg` | Home and About (4:5) | The agents, standing, in the office or in front of the building. Natural light, no forced smiles. |
| `office.jpg` | About, "Find us downtown" (16:10) | Street view of 400 Texas St from across the street, including the trees and street lamps. |

Real photos of the actual office and people beat stock imagery for trust and for local search.
If stock is needed in the meantime, Unsplash has free-to-use courthouse and downtown photos; download and self-host them rather than hotlinking.
